info.name: Kyron AI Security Gateway API
info.description: Pre-configured Postman test suite for Kyron Agent Runtime Security Gateway (/screen endpoint, Token Minting, and Audit Telemetry).

request.description: Logs in as Admin and automatically saves the signed JWT to the {{authToken}} collection variable.
Generates a dedicated Stage 0 Agent Session Token.
Tests a benign prompt and tool call. Kyron evaluates this as clean and returns verdict: 'allow'.
Tests writing inside the authorized /sandbox/* directory path.

item.name: 2.3 ATTACK 1 - Direct Prompt Injection & Secrets Dump (BLOCK)

request.description: Tests Direct Prompt Injection. Intercepted by Stage 1 Regex & Stage 2 ML embeddings with verdict: 'block'.
Tests Deterministic Policy path bounding violation. Prompt is benign, but path /etc/passwd is outside [/sandbox/*, /tmp/*].

item.name: 2.5 ATTACK 3 - Indirect Data Exfiltration to C2 (DOMAIN BLOCK)

request.description: Tests Egress Domain Allowlist violation. Egress destination attacker-webhook.xyz is blocked.
